newsitem.title: USA: Donaldson backs view for higher FY97 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Donaldson backs view for higher FY97 EPS.

text.p: Donaldson Co Inc Chairman William Van Dyke said Tuesday he was comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates of $1.94 to $1.96 a share for fiscal 1997 ending in July.

"The predictions we're getting are in the $1.94 to $1.96 range from different observers, and we're not discouraging those," Van Dyke said after a presentation at a Piper Jaffray investor conference here.
A year earlier the filtration system manufacturer earned $1.67 a share.
Van Dyke told the conference that he expected the company's fiscal 1997 sales to top $800 million, compared with $758.6 million in fiscal 1996.

"We're going to see pretty strong growth in each market, with the possible exception of trucks, which will probably be up slightly in the single-digits," Van Dyke added later. "The construction market continues to run very strong...That's been running at 10 to 15 percent growth."
He said the dust-collection business, which was soft earlier in the fiscal year, has picked up and that the company is "going to see a good year there."
